Fix names so its "First Last" not "Last, First"
```{r, echo=FALSE}
format_player_names <- function(col = Player) { 
  
  df_names <- ls(envir = .GlobalEnv) 
  df_names <- df_names[sapply(df_names, function(x) is.data.frame(get(x, envir = .GlobalEnv)))] 
  
  for (nm in df_names) { 
    df <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv) 
    
    if (as.character(substitute(col)) %in% names(df)) { 
      df <- df %>% 
        mutate({{ col }} := str_replace({{ col }}, "^(.*),\\s*(.*)$", "\\2 \\1"))
      assign(nm, df, envir = .GlobalEnv) 
    } 
  } 
}

format_player_names(col = Player)
```

Change innings pitched from base-3 to base-10 value
```{r, echo=FALSE}
convert_ip <- function(x) { 
  x <- as.numeric(x) 
  whole <- floor(x) 
  decimal <- x - whole 
  
  adj <- dplyr::case_when( 
    abs(decimal - 0.1) < 1e-9 ~ 1/3, 
    abs(decimal - 0.2) < 1e-9 ~ 2/3, 
    TRUE ~ decimal 
  )
  
  whole + adj 
}

for (nm in df_names[grepl("^pitchers", df_names)]) { 
  df <- get(nm) 
  
  if ("ip" %in% names(df)) { 
    df$ip <- convert_ip(df$ip) 
  } 
  
  assign(nm, df, envir = .GlobalEnv) 
  
}
```

Web Scrape for Positions and Age
```{r, echo=FALSE}
team_urls <- tibble(
  team_abbrev = c("RCNJ", "KEAN", "ROW", "WPU", "MSU", "STO", "TCNJ", "NJCU", "RNU", "RCU"),
  url = c(
    "https://ramapoathletics.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://keanathletics.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://www.rowanathletics.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://www.wpupioneers.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://montclairathletics.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://stocktonathletics.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://tcnjathletics.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://njcugothicknights.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://rutgersnewarkathletics.com/sports/baseball/roster/",
    "https://scarletraptors.com/sports/baseball/roster/"
  )
)


df_list <- mget(ls(pattern = "^(hitters|pitchers|fielders)\\d{2}$"))


extract_year <- function(df_name) {
  suffix <- sub("^(hitters|pitchers|fielders)", "", df_name)
  year <- as.integer(paste0("20", suffix))
  return(year)
}


build_url <- function(team_abbrev, year) {
  base <- team_urls$url[team_urls$team_abbrev == team_abbrev]
  paste0(base, year)
}


clean_position <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_split("\n") %>%              
    sapply(function(lines) {
      lines %>%
        str_trim() %>%               
        .[. != ""] 
      
      short_codes <- c("P", "RHP", "LHP", 
                       "C", "1B", "2B", 
                       "3B", "SS", "INF", 
                       "OF", "UTL", "DH")
      
      short_match <- lines[lines %in% short_codes] 
      
      if (length(short_match) > 0) {
        return(short_match[1])
      } else {
          return(lines[1])
        }
    })
}


scrape_team_year <- function(team_abbrev, year) {
  base <- team_urls$url[team_urls$team_abbrev == team_abbrev]
  url <- paste0(base, year)

  message("Scraping: ", url)

  page <- read_html(url)
  players <- page %>% html_nodes(".sidearm-roster-player")

  tibble(
    team = team_abbrev,
    name = players %>% html_node(".sidearm-roster-player-name") %>% html_text(trim = TRUE),
    position = clean_position(players %>% html_node(".sidearm-roster-player-position") %>% html_text(trim = TRUE)),
    class_year = players %>% html_node(".sidearm-roster-player-academic-year") %>% html_text(trim = TRUE)
  )
}



scrape_all_teams_for_year <- function(year) {
  bind_rows(lapply(team_urls$team_abbrev, function(team) {
    scrape_team_year(team, year)
  }))
}


roster_results <- lapply(names(df_list), function(df_name) { 
  df <- df_list[[df_name]] 
  year <- extract_year(df_name) 
  roster <- scrape_all_teams_for_year(year) 
  list( 
    df_name = df_name, 
    year = year, 
    roster = roster 
    ) 
  })
```

Join the scraped data to the stats
```{r}
df_names <- ls(pattern = "^(hitters|pitchers|fielders)\\d{2}$")

for (nm in df_names) {
  
  clean <- function(s) {
    s %>%
      str_replace_all("[\r\n\t]", " ") %>%      
      str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z ]", " ") %>%    
      str_squish() %>%                         
      { 
        map_chr(., function(x) {
          words <- str_split(x, " ", simplify = TRUE)
          n <- ncol(words)
          if (n >= 2) {
            paste(words[, (n-1):n], collapse = " ")
          } else {
            x
          }
        })
      } %>%
      str_to_lower()
  }

  split_name <- function(x) {
    parts <- str_split(x, " ", simplify = TRUE)
    tibble(
      first = parts[,1],
      last  = parts[,ncol(parts)]
    )
  }
  
  df <- get(nm)
  
  match_idx <- which(sapply(roster_results, function(x) x$df_name == nm)) 
  match <- roster_results[[match_idx]]
  match_df <- as_tibble(match$roster)
  
  df_clean <- df %>%
    mutate(clean_name = clean(player)) %>%
    bind_cols(split_name(.$clean_name))
  
  match_clean <- match_df %>%
    mutate(clean_name = clean(name)) %>%
    bind_cols(split_name(.$clean_name))
  
  
  joined <- df_clean %>%
    left_join(
      match_clean %>% select(last, position, class_year, clean_name),
      by = "last"
    )
  
  new_name <- paste0(nm, "_scraped")
  assign(new_name, joined)
}
```

Filter out some of the joins to be more accurate. There are double joins based on last name.
```{r}
scraped_names <- ls(pattern = "^(hitters|pitchers|fielders)\\d{2}_scraped$")

for (nm in scraped_names) {
  
  df <- get(nm)
  
  
  df$name_dist <- stringdist(df$clean_name.x, df$clean_name.y, method = "lv")
  
  df_filtered <- df[df$clean_name.x == df$clean_name.y | 
                      df$name_dist <= 3, ]
  
  assign(nm, df_filtered)
}
```

Filter out duplicated names. These are players with the same exact name that need to be hardcoded.
```{r}
for (nm in scraped_names) {
  
  df <- get(nm)
  dup_names <- df$player[duplicated(df$player)]
  
  if (length(dup_names) == 0) {
    assign(nm, df)
    next
  }
  
  df_filtered <- df %>% 
    filter(!(player %in% dup_names) | clean_name.x == clean_name.y)
  
  df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
    mutate(position = str_trim(position)) %>% 
    filter(
      !((player == "Ken O'Donnell" & team == "WPU" & position == "Pitcher") |
      (player == "Pat O'Donnell" & team == "ROW" & position == "Catcher") |
      (player == "Michael Murray" & team == "TCNJ" & position == "Outfield") |
      (player == "Michael Murray" & team == "RNU" & position == "Infielder") |
      (player == "R.J. McGettigan" & team == "RCU" & position == "First Base/Pitcher" & class_year == "Fr.") |
      (player == "A.J. McGettigan" & team == "RCU" & position == "First Base" & class_year == "Sr.") |
      (player == "Mike Novak" & team == "NJCU" & position == "OF" & class_year == "So.") |
      (player == "Mike Novak" & team == "WPU" & position == "Outfield" & class_year == "FR") |
      (player == "Joey Nolan" & team == "MSU" & position == "C" & class_year == "Fr.")
      )) 
  
  assign(nm, df_filtered)
}
```

Standardize position and calculate attributes for WAR.
Citation for Pitchers WAR: https://library.fangraphs.com/war/calculating-war-pitchers/
Citation for Hitters WAR: https://library.fangraphs.com/war/war-position-players/
```{r}
# Pitchers
pitcher_names <- ls(pattern = "^(pitchers)\\d{2}_merged$")
pitcher_alt <- c("pitcher", "p", "rhp", "right-handed pitcher", "left-handed pitcher",
                 "left-hand pitcher", "lhp", "right handed pitcher", 
                 "left handed pitcher", "right-handed pitcherright-handed pitcher")
pitcher_league_IP <- list()
pitcher_league_Runs <- list()


for (nm in pitcher_names) {

  df <- get(nm)

  year <- sub(".*?(\\d{2})_merged$", "\\1", nm)

  df_filtered <- df %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.integer(year),
      position = str_trim(tolower(position)),
      position = case_when(
        position %in% pitcher_alt ~ "P",
        !position %in% pitcher_alt ~ "P/UTL",
        TRUE ~ position)

      )

  # Get league average stats
  league_stats <- df_filtered %>%
  summarise(
    lg_HR = sum(hr),
    lg_BB = sum(bb),
    lg_HBP = sum(hbp),
    lg_SO = sum(so),
    lg_IP = sum(ip),
    lg_R = sum(r),
    lg_ER = sum(er)
  )

  # Add IP and R to list for hitters df
  pitcher_league_IP[[nm]] <- league_stats$lg_IP
  pitcher_league_Runs[[nm]] <- league_stats$lg_R

  # League average FIP without constant
  lg_FIP_no_const <- (13*league_stats$lg_HR + 3*(league_stats$lg_BB + league_stats$lg_HBP) - 2*league_stats$lg_SO) / league_stats$lg_IP

  # League average ERA
  lg_ERA <- (9 * league_stats$lg_ER) / league_stats$lg_IP

  # League average RA9
  lg_RA9 <- (9 * league_stats$lg_R) / league_stats$lg_IP

  # Adjustment for FIP
  adjustment <- lg_RA9 - lg_ERA

  # FIP constant
  FIP_constant <- lg_ERA - lg_FIP_no_const

  # League average FIP
  lg_FIP <- lg_FIP_no_const + FIP_constant

  # FIPR9
  lg_FIPR9 <- lg_FIP + adjustment

  # FIP, RAA9, RPW, WPGAA, REPlevel, WPGAR, WARa, and WAR for each player
  df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    ip_nonzero = ifelse(ip == 0, NA, ip),
    FIP_no_const = (13*hr + 3*(bb + hbp) - 2*so) / ip_nonzero,
    FIP = FIP_no_const + FIP_constant,
    FIPR9 = FIP + adjustment,
    RAAP9 = lg_FIPR9 - FIPR9,
    RPW = (FIPR9 + 2)*1.5,
    WPGAA = RAAP9/RPW,
    REPlevel = 0.03*(1 - (gs/18)) + 0.12*(gs/18),
    WPGAR = WPGAA + REPlevel,
    WARa = ifelse(ip == 0, 0, WPGAR * (ip/9))
  )

    # Calculate the correction value
    total_WARa <- sum(df_filtered$WARa)
    correction = (16 - total_WARa)/league_stats$lg_IP

    df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
      mutate(
          pWAR = WARa + (correction*ip)
      )

  assign(nm, df_filtered)
}

                    "leftfielder / centerfielder / right-handed pitcher", "left-handed pitcher/outfielder",

                    "left-handed pitcher/leftfielder","pitcher/outfield", "of/rhp", "outfield/pitcher",
                    "right-handed pitcher/outfield", "left-hand pitcher/outfield", "outfielder/pitcher")

catcher_names <- c("catcher", "c", "c/dh", "c/p", "catcher-pitcher", "catcher / right-handed pitcher",
                   "catcher/right-handed pitcher")

utility_names <- c("utility", "ut", "utillity", "catcher/utility", "cather/utility", "infield/outfield",
                   "outfield/infield", "if/of", "of/if", "2b/of", "outfield / first base",
                   "outfield/first base/catcher", "outfield/third base/right-handed pitcher", "of/if/p",
                   "pitcher/first base/outfielder", "pitcher/catcher/outfielder", "middle infielder/outfielder",
                   "infielder/outfielder", "first base/outfield", "first base/outfielder", "first base/outfielder/catcher",
                   "shortstop/outfield", "second base/outfield", "right-handed pitcher/utility",
                   "right-handed pitcher/infield/utility", "catcher/outfield", "catcher/first base",
                   "catcher/first base/third base", "catcher/infielder", "catcher/middle infielder",
                   "catcher / infielder", "catcher/third baseman", "catcher/outfielder", "catcher/first base/designated hitter",
                   "outfield/first base", "outfield/firstbase", "outfield/third base", "outfield/infielder",
                   "outfield/catcher", "first base/catcher", "outfielder/catcher", "designated hitter/right-handed pitcher",
                   "1b/c", "left fielder/first base", "infielder/catcher", "outfielder/third base/right-handed pitcher",
                   "left-handed pitcher/first base/outfielder", "second base/outfielder", "first base-catcher",
                   "outfield-catcher", "first base-outfield", "first base/designated hitter/catcher",
                   "left-handed pitcher/first base", "first baseman/ catcher", "third baseman/leftfielder",
                   "of/c", "pitcher/dh", "outfielder/first base/catcher", "third baseman/outfielder/right-handed pitcher",
                   "left-handed pitcher/outfielder", "inf/of", "pitcher/infield/outfield",
                   "right-handed pitcher/infielder/outfielder", "right-handed pitcher/infield/outfield", "c/1b",
                   "third base/catcher", "1b/of", "p/dh", "c/of", "designated hitter/pitcher", "catcher/infield",
                   "infielder/outfielder/left-handed pitcher", "outfielder/infielder", "outfielder/first base",
                   "pitcher/designated hitter", "right-hand pitcher/utility", "infield/outfied")


for (nm in hitter_names) {

  df <- get(nm)
  
  year <- sub(".*?(\\d{2})_merged$", "\\1", nm)

  df_filtered <- df %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.integer(year),
      position = str_trim(tolower(position)),
      position = case_when(
        position %in% infield_names ~ "INF",
        position %in% outfield_names ~ "OF",
        position %in% catcher_names ~ "C",
        position %in% utility_names ~ "UTL",
        position %in% pitcher_alt ~ "P",
        TRUE ~ position)
      )
  
  # Get league average stats
  league_stats <- df_filtered %>%
  summarise(
    lg_PA = sum(ab) + sum(bb) + sum(hbp) + sum(sf),
    lg_SG = sum(h) - (sum(x2b) + sum(x3b) + sum(hr)),
    lg_DB = sum(x2b),
    lg_TP = sum(x3b),
    lg_HR = sum(hr),
    lg_BB = sum(bb),
    lg_HBP = sum(hbp),
    lg_R = sum(r),
    lg_SB = sum(sb),
    lg_CS = sum(att) - sum(sb),
    lg_GDP = sum(gdp),
    lg_SB_OPP = sum(ab) - sum(h) - sum(so) - sum(hr)
  )
    
    # Pull league sum of IP
    pitcher_key <- sub("^hitters", "pitchers", nm) 
    lg_IP <- pitcher_league_IP[[pitcher_key]]
    lg_Runs <- pitcher_league_Runs[[pitcher_key]]
  
    # wOBA Numerator
    wOBA_num <- ((.69*league_stats$lg_BB) + (.72*league_stats$lg_HBP) + (.88*league_stats$lg_SG) + 
                   (1.24*league_stats$lg_DB) + (1.56*league_stats$lg_TP) + (1.95*league_stats$lg_HR))
    # League wOBA
    lg_wOBA <- wOBA_num/league_stats$lg_PA
    
    # wOBA Scale
    wOBA_scale <- (league_stats$lg_R/league_stats$lg_PA)/(wOBA_num/league_stats$lg_PA)
    
    # League wRC
    lg_wRC <- lg_Runs
    
    # League wSB
    lg_wSB = (league_stats$lg_SB*0.2 + league_stats$lg_CS*(-0.4))
    
    # League wGDP
    lg_wGDP = (league_stats$lg_GDP*(-0.37) + league_stats$lg_SB_OPP*(-0.03))
    
    # League Base Running Runs
    lg_baserun_runs = lg_wSB + lg_wGDP
    
    # League Batting Runs
    lg_bat_runs = 0
    
    # Runs Per Win (RPW)
    rpw = ((9*(lg_Runs/lg_IP))*1.5) + 3
    
    # Calculate wRAA, Batting Runs
    df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      
      # Batting Runs
      singles = h - (x2b + x3b + hr),
      pa = ab + bb + hbp + sf,
      
      wOBA_num = ((.69*bb) + (.72*hbp) + (.88*singles) + (1.24*x2b) + (1.56*x3b) + (1.95*hr)),
      wOBA = wOBA_num/pa,
      
      wRAA = ((wOBA - lg_wOBA)/wOBA_scale)*pa,
      
      bat_runs = wRAA + (lg_Runs/league_stats$lg_PA - lg_wRC/league_stats$lg_PA)*pa,
      
      # Base Running Runs
      wSB = sb*0.2 + (att - sb)*(-0.4),
      sb_opp = ab - h - so - hr,
      wGDP = gdp*(-0.37) + sb_opp*(-0.03),
      
      baserun_runs = wSB + wGDP,
      
      # League Adjustment
      league_adj = ((-1)*(lg_bat_runs + lg_baserun_runs)/league_stats$lg_PA)*pa,
      
      # Replacement Level Runs
      rep_lvl_runs = 0.03*pa,
      
      # WAR
      WARa = ifelse(ab == 0, 0, (wRAA + baserun_runs + league_adj + rep_lvl_runs)/rpw)
    )
    
    # Calculate the correction value
    total_WARa <- sum(df_filtered$WARa)
    correction = (21 - total_WARa)/league_stats$lg_PA

    df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
      mutate(
          hWAR = WARa + (correction*pa)
      )

  assign(nm, df_filtered)
}
```



We add all the hitters to a df and all the pitchers to another.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
nums <- setdiff(10:26, 20)

cols_keep <- c("player", "team", "year", "class_year", "position", "pWAR", "ip", "gs", "app", "era")

pitchers <- bind_rows( 
  lapply(nums, function(n) { 
    df_name <- paste0("pitchers", n, "_merged") 
    df <- get(df_name) 
    df %>% select(all_of(cols_keep)) 
    }) 
  )

cols_keep <- c("player", "team", "year", "class_year", "position", "hWAR", "gs", "gp", "avg")

hitters <- bind_rows( 
  lapply(nums, function(n) { 
    df_name <- paste0("hitters", n, "_merged") 
    df <- get(df_name) 
    df %>% select(all_of(cols_keep)) 
    }) 
  )
```

Add data from standings,
```{r, echo=FALSE}
standings <- bind_rows( 
  lapply(nums, function(y) { 
    df_name <- paste0("standings", y) 
    df <- get(df_name) 
    df %>% 
      mutate(year = y) %>% 
      select(team, year, final_standings)
    }) 
  )


pitchers <- pitchers %>% 
  left_join(standings, by = c("team", "year"))

hitters <- hitters %>% 
  left_join(standings, by = c("team", "year"))



award_winners <- bind_rows(
  lapply(nums, function(y) {
    df_name <- paste0("standings", y)
    df <- get(df_name)
    
    winner_pi <- df %>% filter(pi_oty != "N") %>% pull(pi_oty)
    winner_pl <- df %>% filter(pl_oty != "N") %>% pull(pl_oty)

    tibble(
      award_year = y,
      award_player = winner_pl,
      award_pitcher = winner_pi
    )
  })
)



# Get players who won the award that year
pi_oty_flags <- pitchers %>%
  left_join(award_winners, by = character()) %>%   
  filter(award_year == year) %>%              
  group_by(player, year) %>%
  summarise(
    pi_oty = if_else(any(player == award_pitcher), 1, 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

pitchers <- pitchers %>% 
  left_join(pi_oty_flags, by = c("player", "year")) %>% 
  mutate(pi_oty = replace_na(pi_oty, 0)) %>% 
  rename(pi_oty_won = pi_oty)



pl_oty_flags <- hitters %>%
  left_join(award_winners, by = character()) %>%   
  filter(award_year == year) %>%              
  group_by(player, year) %>%
  summarise(
    pl_oty = if_else(any(player == award_player), 1, 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hitters <- hitters %>% 
  left_join(pl_oty_flags, by = c("player", "year")) %>% 
  mutate(pl_oty = replace_na(pl_oty, 0)) %>% 
    rename(pl_oty_won = pl_oty)


# Get players who have won the award before
pi_oty_flags_has_won <- pitchers %>%
  left_join(award_winners, by = character()) %>%   
  filter(award_year < year) %>%              
  group_by(player, year) %>%
  summarise(
    pi_oty = if_else(any(player == award_pitcher), 1, 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pitchers <- pitchers %>% 
  left_join(pi_oty_flags_has_won, by = c("player", "year")) %>% 
  mutate(pi_oty = replace_na(pi_oty, 0)) %>% 
  rename(pi_oty_has_won = pi_oty)



pl_oty_flags_has_won <- hitters %>%
  left_join(award_winners, by = character()) %>%   
  filter(award_year < year) %>%              
  group_by(player, year) %>%
  summarise(
    pl_oty = if_else(any(player == award_player), 1, 0),

  )

hitters <- hitters %>%
```

We begin modeling with Logistic Regression. We will also use SVM and Random Forest.

Full Attributes for Pitcher Models. I am showing the Significant Factors

Target: Player of the Year for that given year

Attributes:
  -Pitcher WAR
  -Innings Pitched
  -Games Started
  -Appearances
  -Final Standings of the Team
  -Year in School
  -Has the player won the award before
  
  
We want to cut down to players who could win the award. 
Subjective, but we will use the top 20 hitters and pitchers by WAR per year
```{r, echo=FALSE}
most_pitchers <- pitchers %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  arrange(desc(pWAR)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 20)

# Need to add two players who were not top 20 but won the award
not20players <- pitchers %>% 
  filter(
    (player == "Mike Russo" & year == 11) |
    (player == "Ryan Zamorsky" & year == 12)
  )
pitchers_join <- bind_rows(most_pitchers, not20players) 
pitchers_model <- pitchers_join %>% 
  mutate(pWAR_scaled = scale(pWAR))

hitters_model <- hitters %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  arrange(desc(hWAR)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 20) %>% 
  mutate(hWAR_scaled = scale(hWAR))

set.seed(123)
```



Pitchers Logistic Regression. This uses the question "can i predict the award winner for a new year?"
```{r}
cv_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
)

pitchers_logistic <- pitchers_model

pitchers_logistic$pi_oty_won <- factor(pitchers_logistic$pi_oty_won)
levels(pitchers_logistic$pi_oty_won) <- make.names(levels(pitchers_logistic$pi_oty_won))

pitchers_logistic$pi_oty_has_won <- factor(pitchers_logistic$pi_oty_has_won)
levels(pitchers_logistic$pi_oty_has_won) <- make.names(levels(pitchers_logistic$pi_oty_has_won))

model_logp <- train(
  pi_oty_won ~ pWAR_scaled + ip + gs + app + era + final_standings + pi_oty_has_won + class_year_num,
  data = pitchers_logistic,
  method = "glm",
  family = binomial,
  trControl = cv_ctrl,
  metric = "ROC",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale")
)
model_logp

importance_p <- varImp(model_logp)
importance_p

feature_labels <- c(
  "era" = "Earned Run Average",
  "ip" = "Innings Pitched",
  "gs" = "Games Started",
  "app" = "Appearances",
  "pWAR_scaled" = "WAR",
  "final_standings" = "Final Standings",
  "class_year_num" = "Grade",
  "pi_oty_has_wonX1" = "Has Won Award")

ggplot(importance_p, aes(x = reorder(feature, Overall),
                               y = Overall)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = feature_labels) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Logistic Regression Pitchers Feature Importance",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Mean Importance Across Folds")
```




Pitchers SVM.
```{r, echo=FALSE}
pitchers_model$pi_oty_won <- as.factor(pitchers_model$pi_oty_won)
pitchers_model$pi_oty_has_won <- as.factor(pitchers_model$pi_oty_has_won)

years <- sort(unique(pitchers_model$year))
years_shuffled <- sample(years)
folds <- split(years_shuffled, rep(1:5, each = 3))

cv_results_pitchers <- map(folds, function(test_years) {
  
  train_data <- pitchers_model %>% filter(!year %in% test_years)
  test_data  <- pitchers_model %>% filter(year %in% test_years)
  
  model <- svm(
    pi_oty_won ~ pWAR_scaled + ip + gs + app + era + final_standings + pi_oty_has_won + class_year_num,
    data = train_data,
    kernel = "linear"
  )
  
  preds <- predict(model, test_data)
  accuracy <- mean(preds == test_data$pi_oty_won)
  
  mm <- attr(model$terms, "factors")
  mm <- model.matrix(
    formula(model),
    data = train_data
  )
  
  mm <- mm[, -1]
  w <- as.vector(t(model$coefs) %*% model$SV)
  
  svm_features <- colnames(model$SV)
  
  importance <- data.frame(
    feature = svm_features,
    importance = abs(w)
  )
  
  list(
    test_years = test_years,
    accuracy = accuracy,
    importance = importance
  )
})

importance_all_p <- map2_df(
  cv_results_pitchers,
  names(cv_results_pitchers),
  ~ mutate(.x$importance, fold = .y)
)

overall_importance_p <- importance_all_p %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(mean_importance = mean(importance)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_importance)) %>% 
  mutate(scaled_importance = 100 * mean_importance / max(mean_importance))
overall_importance_p

feature_labels <- c(
  "era" = "Earned Run Average",
  "ip" = "Innings Pitched",
  "gs" = "Games Started",
  "app" = "Appearances",
  "pWAR_scaled" = "WAR",
  "final_standings" = "Final Standings",
  "class_year_num" = "Grade",
  "pi_oty_has_won1" = "Has Won Award",
  "pi_oty_has_won0" = "Has Not Won Award")

ggplot(overall_importance_p, aes(x = reorder(feature, scaled_importance),
                               y = scaled_importance)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = feature_labels) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "SVM Pitchers Feature Importance",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Mean Importance Across Folds")
```

Full Attributes for Hitter Models. Once again, I am showing the Significant Factors

Target: Player of the Year for that given year

Attributes:
  -Hitter WAR
  -Games Started
  -Games Played
  -Games Started/Games Played
  -Final Standings of the Team
  -Year in School
  -Has the player won the award before

Hitters Logistic Regression.
```{r, echo=FALSE}
cv_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
)

hitters_logistic <- hitters_model

hitters_logistic$pl_oty_won <- factor(hitters_logistic$pl_oty_won)
levels(hitters_logistic$pl_oty_won) <- make.names(levels(hitters_logistic$pl_oty_won))

hitters_logistic$pl_oty_has_won <- factor(hitters_logistic$pl_oty_has_won)
levels(hitters_logistic$pl_oty_has_won) <- make.names(levels(hitters_logistic$pl_oty_has_won))

model_logh <- train(
  pl_oty_won ~ hWAR_scaled + gs + gp + avg + final_standings + pl_oty_has_won + class_year_num,
  data = hitters_logistic,
  method = "glm",
  family = binomial,
  trControl = cv_ctrl,
  metric = "ROC",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale")
)
model_logh

importance_h <- varImp(model_logh)
importance_h

feature_labels <- c(
  "avg" = "Batting Average",
  "gp" = "Games Played",
  "gs" = "Games Started",
  "hWAR_scaled" = "WAR",
  "final_standings" = "Final Standings",
  "class_year_num" = "Grade",
  "pl_oty_has_wonX1" = "Has Won Award")

ggplot(importance_h, aes(x = reorder(feature, Overall),
                               y = Overall)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = feature_labels) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Logistic Regression Hitters Feature Importance",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Mean Importance Across Folds")
```
 
Hitters SVM.
```{r, echo=FALSE}
hitters_model$pl_oty_won <- as.factor(hitters_model$pl_oty_won)
hitters_model$pl_oty_has_won <- as.factor(hitters_model$pl_oty_has_won)

years <- sort(unique(hitters_model$year))
years_shuffled <- sample(years)
folds <- split(years_shuffled, rep(1:5, each = 3))

cv_results_hitters <- map(folds, function(test_years) {
  
  train_data <- hitters_model %>% filter(!year %in% test_years)
  test_data  <- hitters_model %>% filter(year %in% test_years)
  
  model <- svm(
    pl_oty_won ~ hWAR_scaled + gs + gp + avg + final_standings + pl_oty_has_won + class_year_num,
    data = train_data,
    kernel = "linear"
  )
  
  preds <- predict(model, test_data)
  accuracy <- mean(preds == test_data$pl_oty_won)
  
  mm <- attr(model$terms, "factors")
  mm <- model.matrix(
    formula(model),
    data = train_data
  )
  
  mm <- mm[, -1]
  w <- as.vector(t(model$coefs) %*% model$SV)
  
  svm_features <- colnames(model$SV)
  
  importance <- data.frame(
    feature = svm_features,
    importance = abs(w)
  )
  
  list(
    test_years = test_years,
    accuracy = accuracy,
    importance = importance
  )
})

importance_all_h <- map2_df(
  cv_results_hitters,
  names(cv_results_hitters),
  ~ mutate(.x$importance, fold = .y)
)

overall_importance_h <- importance_all_h %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(mean_importance = mean(importance)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_importance)) %>% 
  mutate(scaled_importance = 100 * mean_importance / max(mean_importance))
overall_importance_h


feature_labels <- c(
  "avg" = "Batting Average",
  "gp" = "Games Played",
  "gs" = "Games Started",
  "hWAR_scaled" = "WAR",
  "final_standings" = "Final Standings",
  "class_year_num" = "Grade",
  "pl_oty_has_won1" = "Has Won Award",
    "pl_oty_has_won0" = "Has Not Won Award")

ggplot(overall_importance_h, aes(x = reorder(feature, scaled_importance),
                               y = scaled_importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = feature_labels) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "SVM Hitters Feature Importance",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Mean Importance Across Folds")
```

Graph of best WAR for year and WAR for winner of Award.
```{r, echo=FALSE}
war_graph_p <- pitchers %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    max_WAR = max(pWAR),
    award_WAR = pWAR[pi_oty_won == 1][1] 
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(max_WAR, award_WAR),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "pWAR"
  )

ggplot(war_graph_p, aes(x = factor(year), y = pWAR, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", colour = "black", size = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) paste0("20", x)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Type", values =  c("award_WAR" = "lightblue", "max_WAR" = "royalblue4"),
                    labels = c("award_WAR" = "Winner WAR", "max_WAR" = "Max WAR")) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "WAR",
       title = "Pitchers: Award Winner WAR vs Max WAR by Year") +
  theme_test()



war_graph_h <- hitters %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    max_WAR = max(hWAR),
    award_WAR = hWAR[pl_oty_won == 1][1] 
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(max_WAR, award_WAR),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "pWAR"
  )

ggplot(war_graph_h, aes(x = factor(year), y = pWAR, fill = type)) +
```

Graphs of Feature importance.
```{r, echo=FALSE}
importance_log <- varImp(model_logp)$importance
importance_log <- importance_log$Overall
names(importance_log) <- rownames(varImp(model_logp)$importance)

importance_svm <- overall_importance_p$scaled_importance
names(importance_svm) <- overall_importance_p$feature

rf_imp <- varImp(rf_model_p)$importance
importance_rf <- as.numeric(rf_imp$X0)
names(importance_rf) <- rownames(rf_imp)


pitchers_importance <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(feature = names(importance_log), importance = importance_log, model = "Logistic"),
  data.frame(feature = names(importance_svm), importance = importance_svm, model = "SVM"),
  data.frame(feature = names(importance_rf), importance = importance_rf, model = "RandomForest"))
rows <- c("pi_oty_has_wonX1", "pi_oty_has_won0", "pi_oty_has_won1")
pitchers_importance <- pitchers_importance %>% 
  filter(!feature %in% rows) %>% 
  group_by(feature) %>% 
  mutate(total_importance = sum(importance)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(feature = reorder(feature, total_importance))

feature_labels <- c(
  "era" = "Earned Run Average",
  "pWAR_scaled" = "WAR",
  "ip" = "Innings Pitched",
  "gs" = "Games Started",

ggplot(pitchers_importance, aes(x = feature, y = importance, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", colour = "black") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = feature_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model",
                    values =  c("Logistic" = "lightblue", "RandomForest" = "royalblue4", "SVM" = "lightgoldenrod"),
                    labels = c("RandomForest" = "Random Forest")) +
  labs(title = "Pitchers: Feature Importance Across Models",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Importance") +
  theme_test() + 
  coord_flip()
```
